title: Slow Roasted Mexican Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this slow-roasted tagine is filled with tender meat, rich flavors, and a hint of spices.

ingredients.name: slow-roasted meat (chicken or beef)
ingredients.notes: such as short ribs or chicken thighs

instructions: Season the slow-roasted meat with cumin, coriander, and red pepper flakes.
Heat oil in the bottom of a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the meat until browned on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the plum tomatoes, tagine spice mix, and browned meat back to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
